# R14 + R15 + R16 - companions: size by stakes, telemetry routing, roles (design for review, wave 25)

Goal: a panel takes as many companions as the stakes need, from as many labs as it can, chosen
by their track record with a share of exploration, and a companion can take a narrow role.
Today `-Panel` takes every available roster entry (weighty ones only on weighty purposes) in
roster order; selection is deterministic and telemetry (`-Rate`, the scoreboard) is only read
by humans.

## Code facts

- `Select-PanelMembers` (common.ps1) walks the roster: availability (preflight, endpoint health,
  peak), then `panel: weighty` vs the purpose (`$script:WeightyPurposes`), `-PanelAll`.
- Ratings live in `findings.json` `ratings[]` (`-Rate <n> -Useful yes|partly|no -Note`), joined
  to the ledger entry by n; `codex-scoreboard.ps1` aggregates per (lineage, purpose) across all
  tasks of the repository (`Read-AllTaskConsults` reads every ledger already, for endpoint
  health).
- Purposes: framing, decision, checkpoint, core-contract, acceptance, diff-review, stuck, chore
  (+ none); presets set effort and max words.

## Design

R14 - size and diversity
1. Default panel size per purpose: checkpoint 1, diff-review 2, framing 3, decision 3,
   core-contract 4, acceptance 4, stuck: all available. `-PanelSize <n>` overrides (n >= 1);
   `-PanelAll` = all available (unchanged). The size counts members that will RUN; skipped
   entries never count.
2. Lab diversity: optional roster field `lab` (free text, e.g. `deepseek`, `moonshot`, `zhipu`,
   `google`, `bytedance`, `alibaba`, `xiaomi`, `meta`, `openai`); default = the provider label.
   Filling a panel of size k: first one member per distinct lab (best-ranked of each lab), then
   the rest by rank. Validation: `lab` is a non-empty string.
3. The design floor is a rule, not code: the consult-codex skill states that framing and
   decision questions go to a panel of at least one companion (never only the author's own
   judgement), and `-Panel` on those purposes warns when fewer than 2 members will run.
4. Documented diminishing returns (README): past about five diverse members, findings repeat.

R15 - telemetry routing
5. Rank = a score per (roster entry, purpose[, topics]) from the ratings of the last 90 days
   across all tasks of the repository: score = 1 + sum(yes) + 0.5*sum(partly) - sum(no), floor
   0.25; a lineage with no ratings on this purpose scores its all-purpose score, else the
   neutral 1. Topics: `-Topic a,b` on the bridge (ledger `topics[]`, the scoreboard gains
   `-By topic`); a rating counts for the topics of its consultation; the score for a topic'd
   request = mean of the purpose score and the topic scores that exist.
6. Selection = weighted draw without replacement over the eligible entries (weights = scores),
   with exploration: with probability 0.2 per slot the slot is filled uniformly from the eligible
   rest. The RNG is seeded per panel (the panel id) and the ledger's `panel` object gains
   `routing: { seed, eligible: [{lineage, score, lab}], picked: [...], explored: [...] }`;
   the dry run prints the same. `-PanelOrder roster` restores today's deterministic order (and
   is the behaviour when no ratings exist at all: draw with equal weights = roster order? No -
   equal weights still shuffle; with no ratings the order is the roster order, documented).
7. Single runs (`-Provider` absent, no `-Panel`): today the first available roster entry. R15
   changes nothing there (the coordinator asked for one reviewer; the roster order is the
   coordinator's ranking).

R16 - roles
8. `-Role <name>`: a role block from `templates/role-<name>.md` appended to the prompt after
   the ask (edge-cases, security, tests, docs shipped; a repository may add its own under
   `.collab/roles/`), recorded as ledger `role`; `-Panel -Role x` gives the same role to every
   member; `-Roles a,b,c` (panel only) assigns roles in order to the picked members (the rest:
   none). Roles change the prompt only - members stay read-only, verdict rules unchanged.

## Tests (fakes only)

Sizes per purpose and `-PanelSize`; lab diversity (two entries of one lab, one of another:
size 2 picks one of each); the floor warning; scores from synthetic ratings (yes/partly/no,
the 90-day cut, the fallback chain); the seeded draw is reproducible (same seed -> same pick)
and exploration happens at the recorded rate over many seeds; `-PanelOrder roster`; the
ledger's routing record and the dry-run text; `-Topic` in the ledger and `-By topic`;
`-Role` block in the prompt and ledger, unknown role refused, `-Roles` assignment order.

## Questions for the reviewers

Q1. The score formula (additive, floor 0.25, 90-day window): sane, or should it be a rate (yes
    over rated) with a confidence prior (few ratings -> pull to neutral)?
Q2. Exploration 0.2 per slot: right order of magnitude for a roster of ~10 and a few panels a
    day? Any reason to make it decay with the number of ratings?
Q3. Diversity before rank: any case where it picks a clearly worse lab representative over a
    better second model of the same lab that the coordinator would regret?
Q4. Should a role change the purpose presets (effort, max words), or stay prompt-only?

## Addendum (2026-09-26, the maintainer's request): availability the operator can act on

The maintainer: the operator should see, briefly, which reviewers are out on a limit and until
when, because some topics should not be started without a particular reviewer.

9. Availability line, sharpened: the SessionStart hook line (and `codex-providers.ps1 -Short`,
   new) names only what is OUT, per roster entry (not per provider label), with the reset time
   in local time and a relative hint: `codex-consult: out - openai :: gpt-6-astra (until Sun
   20:35, 2d 10h), gemini :: * (until Sun 21:30); 9 of 11 reviewers available`. Every entry
   available: `codex-consult: all 11 reviewers available`. A quota failure WITHOUT a known reset
   (e.g. BytePlus 429 at 10:31 today, which the hook still reports as available) marks the
   endpoint "out (limit hit 10:31, reset unknown - retry after 60 min)" for 60 minutes.
10. `-Require <lineage[,lineage]>` on `-Panel` (and on a single run with `-Provider`): the run is
    refused BEFORE anything starts when a required reviewer is unavailable, printing who and
    until when, exit 5; the dry run shows the same. The roster may carry the default:
    `"require": { "acceptance": ["openai :: gpt-6-astra"], "framing": [...] }` per purpose.
11. The consult-codex skill: before a framing, decision, core-contract or acceptance panel the
    coordinator runs the availability check and, when a reviewer the topic needs is out, tells
    the operator who is out and until when and asks whether to wait or to proceed without them -
    never silently proceeds. The bridge's own summary already names skipped members; this rule
    moves the decision before the run.

Q5. Should "out" be judged per roster entry (two agy models share one quota - both out) or per
    endpoint group as `Get-PanelPlan` defines it, and how should the hook line stay one line with
    an 11-entry roster?

2496: # Per-run Codex config overrides: -CodexConfig and a roster entry's codex_config follow the
2497: # same rules. Each item is key=value; one string may carry several, split only at a comma
2498: # that starts the next key=, so a value like [1,2] stays whole. Keys that would change what
2499: # the ledger records (model, model_provider, profile, model_reasoning_effort,
2500: # model_providers.*) are refused. A value starting with ~/ or ~\ gets the home directory
2501: # ($HOME, else USERPROFILE) and forward slashes (Codex does not expand ~; on Windows
2502: # `~/...` fails with os error 123). A value that is not a TOML literal is wrapped in double
2503: # quotes (Codex parses the value as TOML and falls back to a literal string, so a bare path
2504: # is a TOML string either way). { Items (string[], as passed to codex and recorded in the
2505: # ledger); Error ('' or the message, prefixed by $Label) }.
2506: function ConvertFrom-CodexConfigItems {
2507:     param([string[]]$Values, [string]$Label = '-CodexConfig')
2508:     $items = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
2509:     foreach ($cfgArg in @($Values)) {
2510:         if (-not $cfgArg -or -not $cfgArg.Trim()) { continue }
2511:         foreach ($item in ($cfgArg.Trim() -split ',(?=\s*[A-Za-z0-9_.]+=)')) {
2512:             $item = $item.Trim()
2513:             if ($item -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_.]+=.+$') {
2514:                 return [pscustomobject]@{ Items = [string[]]@(); Error = "$Label '$item' is malformed: expected key=value (key: letters, digits, _ and .; a non-empty value)." }
2515:             }
2516:             $cfgKey = $item.Substring(0, $item.IndexOf('='))
2517:             $cfgValue = $item.Substring($item.IndexOf('=') + 1)
2518:             if (@('model', 'model_provider', 'profile', 'model_reasoning_effort', 'model_providers') -ccontains $cfgKey -or $cfgKey.StartsWith('model_providers.', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) {
2519:                 return [pscustomobject]@{ Items = [string[]]@(); Error = "$Label '$item' is refused: $cfgKey is part of the reviewer identity and effort the bridge records (use -Model / -Provider / -Effort; providers belong in the Codex config)." }
2520:             }
2521:             if ($cfgValue -match '^~[\\/]') {
2522:                 $homeDir = $HOME
2523:                 if (-not $homeDir) { $homeDir = $env:USERPROFILE }
2524:                 $cfgValue = (($homeDir.TrimEnd([char]'\', [char]'/') + $cfgValue.Substring(1)) -replace '\\', '/')
2525:             }
2526:             if ($cfgValue -notmatch '^(["''0-9\[{]|true$|false$)') { $cfgValue = '"' + (ConvertTo-TomlBasicString $cfgValue) + '"' }
2527:             $items.Add("$cfgKey=$cfgValue")
2528:         }
2529:     }
2530:     return [pscustomobject]@{ Items = [string[]]$items.ToArray(); Error = '' }
2531: }

1: <#
2: .SYNOPSIS
3:     SessionStart hook: one line saying which reviewers are usable right now.
4: 
5: .DESCRIPTION
6:     Runs at the start of a Claude Code session in any project where the plugin is
7:     enabled (hooks/hooks.json). Prints ONE line to stdout, which Claude Code adds to the
8:     agent's context:
9: 
10:         codex-consult: reviewers - openai available | ZAI available | mimo unavailable
11:         (missing: env MIMO_API_KEY not set); roster -> would select ZAI
12: 
13:     or, when the Codex CLI is not on PATH, `codex-consult: codex CLI not found on PATH -
14:     follow the setup-providers skill`. Everything else (an unreadable config, an unusable
15:     roster, a crash inside the check) is reported in the same one-line form and never
16:     fails the session: the exit code is always 0. No network call, no lock, nothing
17:     written: it runs `codex-providers.ps1 -Json -NoNetwork` - the same local check
18:     codex-providers.ps1 makes (credentials, table usability, endpoint health from THIS
19:     repository's ledgers, the roster walk), except that the sign-in of an engine provider
20:     (the agy engine's `agy models`, a network round-trip) is NOT checked here: such a row
21:     reads e.g. `gemini not checked (launcher present)` (a missing launcher stays
22:     `gemini unavailable (agy CLI not found on PATH)`; a recorded auth failure or usage
23:     limit still shows), and the roster walk skips it - unless THIS repository's ledgers
24:     hold a usable reply on that engine's endpoint from the last 60 minutes, which evidences
25:     the sign-in without any call (`gemini available`). `codex-providers.ps1` without
26:     -NoNetwork and the consultation's own preflight do check it. The muse engine's sign-in
27:     check (wave 23) reads ~/.config/muse/auth.json locally and so runs here too (`meta
28:     available`), as does its billing guard (`meta unavailable (refused: META_API_KEY is
29:     set: ...)`).
30: 
31:     Cost: about one second (`codex login status` for the built-in openai), once per
32:     session. Disable the hook by disabling the plugin's hooks in Claude Code settings.
33: 
34:     Runs on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
35: #>
36: [CmdletBinding()]
37: param(
38:     # Where consultations are stored (endpoint health is read from every task ledger
39:     # under it). Relative paths resolve against the git repo root of the current directory.
40:     [string]$CollabDir = '.collab'
41: )
42: 
43: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
44: $line = ''
45: try {
46:     $providers = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'codex-providers.ps1'
47:     $psExe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
48:     $codex = Get-Command codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
49:     if (-not $codex) {
50:         $line = 'codex-consult: codex CLI not found on PATH - follow the setup-providers skill before consulting a reviewer'
51:     } else {
52:         $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
53:         $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
54:         $raw = & $psExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $providers -Json -NoNetwork -CollabDir $CollabDir 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" }
55:         $code = $LASTEXITCODE
56:         $ErrorActionPreference = $previous
57:         $jsonStart = -1
58:         for ($i = 0; $i -lt $raw.Count; $i++) { if ($raw[$i] -match '^\s*\[') { $jsonStart = $i; break } }
59:         if ($jsonStart -lt 0) {
60:             $first = (@($raw | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim() }) | Select-Object -First 1)
61:             if (-not $first) { $first = "codex-providers.ps1 exited $code without output" }
62:             $line = "codex-consult: reviewer check failed - $first"
63:         } else {
64:             # Pipeline form on purpose: on Windows PowerShell 5.1 `ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject`
65:             # hands a JSON array back as ONE object, which @() would not unroll.
66:             $jsonText = ($raw[$jsonStart..($raw.Count - 1)]) -join "`n"
67:             $rows = @()
68:             foreach ($item in ($jsonText | ConvertFrom-Json)) { $rows += $item }
69:             $parts = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
70:             $selected = ''
71:             foreach ($r in $rows) {
72:                 $verdict = [string]$r.verdict
73:                 $short = $verdict
74:                 if ($verdict -match '^(available|unavailable|unknown)\s*(\((.*)\))?$') {
75:                     $short = $Matches[1]
76:                     if ($Matches[3]) {
77:                         $reason = $Matches[3]
78:                         if ($reason.Length -gt 60) { $reason = $reason.Substring(0, 57) + '...' }
79:                         $short += " ($reason)"
80:                     }
81:                 }
82:                 # an engine row whose sign-in was not checked (-NoNetwork): say so plainly
83:                 $rowEngine = [string]$r.engine
84:                 if ($rowEngine -and $rowEngine -ne 'codex' -and ([string]$r.credentials).StartsWith('not checked') -and $verdict -like 'unknown*') { $short = 'not checked (launcher present)' }
85:                 $parts.Add("$($r.name) $short")
86:                 if ($r.roster_selected -eq $true) { $selected = [string]$r.name }
87:             }
88:             $line = 'codex-consult: reviewers - ' + ($parts.ToArray() -join ' | ')
89:             if ($selected) { $line += "; roster -> would select $selected" }
90:             elseif (@($rows | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.roster_position }).Count -gt 0) { $line += '; roster -> no entry is available' }
91:         }
92:     }
93: } catch {
94:     $msg = ("$($_.Exception.Message)" -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
95:     if ($msg.Length -gt 120) { $msg = $msg.Substring(0, 117) + '...' }
96:     $line = "codex-consult: reviewer check failed - $msg"
97: }
98: Write-Output $line
99: exit 0

1: <#
2: .SYNOPSIS
3:     List the Codex model providers and whether each one is usable right now.
4: 
5: .DESCRIPTION
6:     Reads the Codex config (<codex home>/config.toml, the constrained scanner of
7:     codex-consult-common.ps1) and reports the built-in openai plus every
8:     [model_providers.<name>] table - and (0.4.0) one row per provider label that the
9:     reviewer roster declares with another engine than codex (e.g. "engine": "agy" or, wave
10:     23, "engine": "muse"):
11: 
12:       verdict      available               credentials present and the table usable
13:                    unavailable (<reason>)  credentials missing, the table unusable, an
14:                                            auth failure on this endpoint <= 24 h ago, or
15:                                            a usage limit whose reset time lies ahead
16:                                            ("usage limit until <iso>")
17:                    unknown (<reason>)      `codex login status` could not run, or the
18:                                            config cannot be scanned
19:       kind         builtin | custom | engine <name> (JSON `engine`: codex for the first two)
20:       endpoint     canonical base_url, or builtin:openai[+OPENAI_BASE_URL <url>], or
21:                    "<engine> (<launcher>)" for an engine row
22:       table        built in | usable | unusable: <scanner reason> | n/a (an engine row)
23:       credentials  openai (and tables with requires_openai_auth = true): the output of
24:                    `codex login status` (timeout 15 s) - "ok: Logged in ..." or
25:                    "missing: <first line or exit N>"; other tables: "ok: env NAME set",
26:                    "ok: bearer token in config", "missing: env NAME not set" or
27:                    "missing: no env_key/bearer token in the table"; an agy row: `agy models`
28:                    (a network round-trip, usually ~2 s, timeout 45 s, once per listing) -
29:                    "ok: signed in (N models)", "missing: ..." (sign-in wording, or "agy CLI
30:                    not found on PATH"), "unknown: ..."; no call when THIS repository's
31:                    ledgers hold a usable reply on the agy endpoint from the last 60 minutes:
32:                    "ok: signed in (usable reply <m> min ago)" (with -NoNetwork too; a
33:                    recorded auth failure or usage limit still makes the verdict
34:                    unavailable); otherwise with -NoNetwork "not checked (launcher present;
35:                    run codex-providers.ps1)" and the verdict "unknown (sign-in not checked)";
36:                    a muse row (wave 23): ~/.config/muse/auth.json with TBH_CREDENTIAL_BACKEND=file
37:                    (local, also with -NoNetwork; key names and providers.meta.mechanism only) -
38:                    "ok: signed in (...mechanism oauth)", "missing: not signed in: ...",
39:                    "unknown: sign-in not checkable: ..." (the keychain backend). A muse row
40:                    whose launch the billing guard refuses (META_API_KEY or MODEL_API_KEY set,
41:                    a mechanism other than oauth, or - wave 23b - no oauth sign-in established:
42:                    the keychain backend, no auth.json, no mechanism) is "unavailable (refused:
43:                    ...)"
44:       effort       the effort vocabulary DECLARED for the endpoint (capability table
45:                    caps-v1): openai (built-in openai, any model), zai (api.z.ai /
46:                    open.bigmodel.cn), mimo (*.xiaomimimo.com token-plan / api hosts) -
47:                    those two for their declared models only (JSON effort_models) - or
48:                    "unknown (needs -NativeEffort)"; an agy row: "agy (tier in the model id)";
49:                    a muse row: "muse (2 declared models)" (JSON effort_models)
50:       transport    (JSON schema_transport) how the reply schema reaches the endpoint:
51:                    output-schema (--output-schema) or prompt-only (MiMo, undeclared hosts);
52:                    native for an engine row (agy --json-schema, muse --output-schema)
53:       last failure the newest failed consultation of this provider's ENDPOINT
54:                    (provider_fingerprint, whatever alias ran it) in THIS repository's
55:                    <CollabDir>/*/sessions.json within the last 24 h, with its class
56:                    (auth | quota | capability | transport | unknown; "quota until <iso>"
57:                    when the provider named its reset time; JSON last_failure and
58:                    last_limit = the newest quota failure, each with retry_after). An
59:                    auth failure not followed by a successful run, and a usage limit
60:                    until a reset time still ahead, make the verdict unavailable (a
61:                    usage limit without a reset time does not). Entries recorded before
62:                    0.3.0 count as the built-in openai endpoint. Health is read at the
63:                    consult clock (CODEX_CONSULT_NOW, a test hook).
64:       roster       with a reviewer roster (CODEX_CONSULT_ROSTER - it must exist, "none"
65:                    = no roster - else <codex home>/codex-consult-roster.json when it
66:                    exists): the ROSTER column (the
67:                    provider's entry positions, or -; JSON roster_position = the first,
68:                    or null; roster_selected = the entry a consultation without -Provider
69:                    and -Thread would use now) and a final line
70:                    "roster: <path> -> would select <provider> :: <model> (skipped: ...)"
71:                    or "roster: <path> -> no entry is available (skipped: ...)". An
72:                    unusable roster file, or a CODEX_CONSULT_ROSTER file that does not
73:                    exist, is refused (exit 1). "auth": "none" in the
74:                    roster makes a table without env_key/bearer token "ok: declared
75:                    anonymous in the roster".
76: 
77:     No network call for codex providers; at most one `agy models` call per agy engine (none
78:     after a usable agy reply within the last 60 minutes, none with -NoNetwork, which the
79:     SessionStart hook uses); nothing is written; no task lock is taken.
80:     Exit codes: with -Provider <name>: 0 available, 2 unavailable, 3 unknown, 1 usage
81:     error (e.g. no such provider). Without -Provider: 0.
82: 
83: .EXAMPLE
84:     powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File codex-providers.ps1
85: 
86: .EXAMPLE
87:     pwsh -NoProfile -File codex-providers.ps1 -Provider ZAI -Json
88: #>
89: [CmdletBinding()]
90: param(
91:     # Report this provider only (case-sensitive, as in the config); sets the exit code.
92:     [string]$Provider = '',
93: 
94:     # Where consultations are stored (for the last usage-limit failure). Relative paths
95:     # resolve against the git repo root.
96:     [string]$CollabDir = '.collab',
97: 
98:     # An array of objects instead of the table.
99:     [switch]$Json,
100: 
101:     # Explicit path to the codex launcher (for `codex login status`). Env override:
102:     # CODEX_CONSULT_EXE.
103:     [string]$CodexExe = '',
104: 
105:     # Explicit path to the launcher of an engine other than codex (for `agy models`, the muse
106:     # rows' launcher): the engine of the -Provider row, else the only such engine of the roster
107:     # (several: pass -Provider). Env overrides: CODEX_CONSULT_AGY_EXE, CODEX_CONSULT_MUSE_EXE.
108:     [string]$EngineExe = '',
109: 
110:     # No network call at all: an agy row's sign-in is "not checked" (the SessionStart hook); a
111:     # muse row's check is local and still runs.
112:     [switch]$NoNetwork
113: )
114: 
115: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
116: $script:ToolName = 'codex-providers'
117: . (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'codex-consult-common.ps1')
118: 
119: $launcher = Resolve-CodexLauncher -Explicit $CodexExe
120: $configPath = Get-CodexConfigPath
121: $config = Read-CodexConfigSubset -Path $configPath
122: $where = if ($configPath) { $configPath } else { '(no Codex home)' }
123: $fileReason = ''
124: if ($config.Exists -and -not $config.Ok) { $fileReason = $config.Reason }
125: 
126: $names = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
127: $names.Add('openai')
128: foreach ($n in (Get-ProviderNames -Config $config)) { if ($n -cne 'openai') { $names.Add($n) } }
129: 
130: # Every task ledger of this repository (health is read per ENDPOINT across all of them, at
131: # the consult clock: CODEX_CONSULT_NOW freezes it in tests).
132: $repoRoot = Resolve-RepoRoot -Cwd (Get-Location).Path
133: $collabRoot = Resolve-CollabRoot -RepoRoot $repoRoot -CollabDir $CollabDir
134: $consults = Read-AllTaskConsults -CollabRoot $collabRoot
135: $clock = Get-ConsultClock -Peek
136: if ($clock.Error) { Stop-WithError $clock.Error }
137: $utcNow = $clock.Now.UtcDateTime
138: 
139: # The reviewer roster (as codex-consult.ps1 reads it): which entry a consultation without
140: # -Provider and -Thread would select now.
141: $roster = Read-ReviewerRoster
142: if ($roster.Error) { Stop-WithError $roster.Error }
143: # The provider labels of the other engines (0.4.0): one row each, in roster order.
144: $engineLaunchers = @{}
145: if ($EngineExe) {
146:     # (wave 23, D3) -EngineExe names the launcher of the SELECTED engine other than codex
147:     $exeBinding = Resolve-EngineExeBinding -Roster $roster -Provider $Provider
148:     if ($exeBinding.Error) { Stop-WithError "$($exeBinding.Error)." }
149:     $engineLaunchers[$exeBinding.Engine] = [string](Resolve-EngineLauncher -Engine $exeBinding.Engine -Explicit $EngineExe)
150: }
151: $engineLabels = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
152: foreach ($e in @($roster.Entries)) {
153:     if ($e.Engine -eq 'codex') { continue }
154:     if (@($engineLabels | Where-Object { $_.Name -ceq $e.Provider }).Count -eq 0) { $engineLabels.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = $e.Provider; Engine = $e.Engine }) }
155: }
156: if ($Provider) {
157:     $known = @($names.ToArray()) + @($engineLabels | ForEach-Object { $_.Name })
158:     if ($known -cnotcontains $Provider) {
159:         Stop-WithError "no provider '$Provider' in $where (providers: $($known -join ', '))."
160:     }
161:     $keep = $names.Contains($Provider) -and @($engineLabels | Where-Object { $_.Name -ceq $Provider }).Count -eq 0
162:     $names = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
163:     if ($keep) { $names.Add($Provider) }
164:     $engineLabels = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
165:     foreach ($e in @($roster.Entries)) {
166:         if ($e.Engine -ne 'codex' -and $e.Provider -ceq $Provider -and $engineLabels.Count -eq 0) { $engineLabels.Add([pscustomobject]@{ Name = $e.Provider; Engine = $e.Engine }) }
167:     }
168: }
169: $loginCache = @{}
170: $walk = $null
171: if ($roster.Exists) {
172:     $walk = Select-RosterReviewer -Roster $roster -Config $config -Consults $consults -Launcher ([string]$launcher) -LoginCache $loginCache -UtcNow $utcNow -OpenAiBaseUrl ([string]$env:OPENAI_BASE_URL) -EngineLaunchers $engineLaunchers -NoNetwork:$NoNetwork
173: }
174: 
175: $rows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
176: foreach ($name in $names) {
177:     $tableName = '[' + (Format-TomlPath @('model_providers', $name)) + ']'
178:     $pt = $null
179:     $setProblem = ''
180:     if ($config.Exists -and $config.Ok) {
181:         $pt = Get-ProviderTable -Config $config -Name $name
182:         $setProblem = Get-ProviderSetProblem -Config $config -Name $name
183:     }
184:     $kind = if ($name -ceq 'openai') { 'builtin' } else { 'custom' }
185:     $endpoint = ''
186:     $wire = ''
187:     $tableState = 'built in'
188:     $tableOk = $true
189:     $vocab = ''
190:     $hostName = ''
191:     if ($pt -and $pt.Found) {
192:         if ($pt.Ok) {
193:             $ep = Get-ProviderEndpoint -Table $pt.Table -TableName $tableName -Where $where
194:             if ($ep.Error) { $tableOk = $false; $tableState = "unusable: $($ep.Error)" }
195:             else {
196:                 $tableState = 'usable'
197:                 $endpoint = if ($ep.BaseUrl) { ($ep.BaseUrl -replace '\?.*$', '?...') } else { '(default)' }
198:                 if ($name -ceq 'openai') { $endpoint += ' (user-defined table)' }
199:                 $wire = $ep.WireApi
200:                 $hostName = $ep.HostName
201:             }
202:         } else { $tableOk = $false; $tableState = "unusable: $($pt.Reason)" }
203:     } elseif ($name -ceq 'openai') {
204:         $endpoint = 'builtin:openai'
205:         $hostName = 'builtin:openai'
206:         $wire = '(built in)'
207:         if ($env:OPENAI_BASE_URL -and $env:OPENAI_BASE_URL.Trim()) {
208:             $cu = ConvertTo-CanonicalBaseUrl $env:OPENAI_BASE_URL
209:             $endpoint += "+OPENAI_BASE_URL $($cu.Url -replace '\?.*$', '?...')"
210:             $hostName = $cu.HostName
211:         }
212:     } else {
213:         $tableOk = $false
214:         $tableState = 'unusable: the config cannot be scanned'
215:     }
216:     $effortModels = $null
217:     $transport = 'prompt-only'
218:     if ($hostName -and $script:EffortCaps.ContainsKey($hostName)) { $transport = $script:EffortCaps[$hostName].SchemaTransport }
219:     if ($hostName -and $script:EffortCaps.ContainsKey($hostName)) {
220:         $vocab = $script:EffortCaps[$hostName].Vocabulary
221:         $effortModels = if ($null -eq $script:EffortCaps[$hostName].Models) { 'any' } else { [object[]]$script:EffortCaps[$hostName].Models }
222:     } else { $vocab = 'unknown (needs -NativeEffort)' }
223: 
224:     $credText = 'not checked (table unusable)'
225:     $verdict = ''
226:     if ($fileReason) {
227:         $credText = 'not checked (config unreadable)'
228:         $verdict = "unknown (config unreadable: $fileReason)"
229:     } elseif ($setProblem) {
230:         $credText = 'not checked (providers could not be established)'
231:         $verdict = "unknown (the providers could not be established: $setProblem)"
232:     } elseif (-not $tableOk) {
233:         $verdict = "unavailable (table $tableState)"
234:     } else {
235:         $table = $null
236:         if ($pt -and $pt.Found) { $table = $pt.Table }
237:         $anonymous = [bool](@($roster.Entries | Where-Object { $_.Provider -ceq $name -and $_.Auth -eq 'none' }).Count -gt 0)
238:         $cred = Get-ProviderCredential -Name $name -Table $table -Launcher ([string]$launcher) -LoginCache $loginCache -Anonymous:$anonymous
239:         $credText = $cred.Detail
240:         if ($cred.State -eq 'ok') { $verdict = 'available' }
241:         elseif ($cred.State -eq 'missing') { $verdict = "unavailable ($($cred.Detail))" }
242:         else { $verdict = "unknown ($($cred.Reason))" }
243:     }
244: 
245:     # Recorded health of this provider's ENDPOINT (fingerprint), whatever alias ran it.
246:     $health = $null
247:     if (-not $fileReason -and -not $setProblem -and $tableOk) {
248:         $probe = Resolve-ReviewerIdentity -Config $config -Provider $name -Model 'health-probe' -OpenAiBaseUrl ([string]$env:OPENAI_BASE_URL)
249:         if ($probe.Resolved) { $health = Get-EndpointHealth -Consults $consults -Fingerprint $probe.Fingerprint -UtcNow $utcNow }

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Usefulness telemetry: which reviewer was useful on which kind of question.

.DESCRIPTION
    Reads the ledgers (<CollabDir>/<task>/sessions.json) and findings stores
    (<CollabDir>/<task>/findings.json) of EVERY task of this repository, or of one task
    with -Task, and prints one row per (reviewer lineage, purpose), a total row per
    lineage and a grand total. Nothing is written, no lock is taken; a store that cannot
    be read is reported and left out. Exit 0.

    Row key
      REVIEWER   '<provider> :: <model>' of the consultation (its ledger reviewer), with
                 ' [<engine>]' appended for an engine other than codex (0.4.0, e.g.
                 'gemini :: gemini-3.8-flash-high [agy]'; an absent reviewer.engine is
                 codex); 'unknown provenance' for entries recorded before 0.3.0 (no reviewer)
      PURPOSE    the consultation's purpose, '(none)' without one; '(total)' on a
                 lineage's total row; the grand total row is '(all) (total)'
    Columns (JSON field in brackets)
      CONSULTS   ledger entries [consults]
      USABLE     bridge_outcome 'usable reply' [usable]
      PROSE      usable, but no valid structured reply (-Raw, chore, invalid JSON) [prose]
      FAILED     every other outcome [failed]
      RAISED     findings raised by these consultations (a finding belongs to the
                 consultation it was ingested from: source.consult = the entry's n, in
                 the same task - the join codex-findings.ps1 -Stats uses) [raised]
      VERIFIED / REJECTED / WONTFIX / SUPERSEDED   their current status [verified,
                 rejected, wontfix, superseded]
      OPEN       proposed + implemented [open]
      HIT%       verified / (verified + rejected), rounded percent; '-' when both are 0
                 [hit_rate: a number, or null]
      A/H/R/D    verdicts ACCEPT / HOLD / REJECT / ADVISE [verdict_accept, verdict_hold,
                 verdict_reject, verdict_advise]
      Y/P/N      the judge's usefulness marks (codex-findings.ps1 -Rate): yes / partly /
                 no [rated_yes, rated_partly, rated_no]
      MEDIAN_S   median wall_seconds; '-' when none [median_wall_seconds: number or null]
      TOKENS     input tokens not served from the cache / output tokens [tokens_in,
                 tokens_out]
    Findings whose consultation has no ledger entry count as 'unknown provenance' /
    '(none)'. Rows are sorted by lineage (case-insensitive; unknown provenance last),
    then purpose. -Json prints an array of the same rows with numeric fields (plus
    `kind`: purpose | lineage | total).

.EXAMPLE
    powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File codex-scoreboard.ps1

.EXAMPLE
    pwsh -NoProfile -File codex-scoreboard.ps1 -Task cache-rewrite -Json
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    # Where consultations are stored. Relative paths resolve against the git repo root.
    [string]$CollabDir = '.collab',

    # One task only (its directory under <CollabDir>).
    [string]$Task = '',

    # An array of row objects instead of the table.
    [switch]$Json
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$script:ToolName = 'codex-scoreboard'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'codex-consult-common.ps1')

if ($Task -and $Task -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$') {
    Stop-WithError "-Task must be a slug (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore)."
}
$repoRoot = Resolve-RepoRoot -Cwd (Get-Location).Path
$collabRoot = Resolve-CollabRoot -RepoRoot $repoRoot -CollabDir $CollabDir

$taskDirs = @()
if ($Task) {
    $one = Join-Path $collabRoot $Task
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $one -PathType Container)) { Stop-WithError "no task '$Task' under $collabRoot." }
    $taskDirs = @(Get-Item -LiteralPath $one)
} elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath $collabRoot -PathType Container) {
    $taskDirs = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $collabRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name)
}

# Tolerant reads: a store that does not parse is reported and left out.
$notes = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
function Read-TolerantStore {
    param([string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
    try { return (ConvertFrom-JsonKeepOffset -Text (Read-SharedText -Path $Path)) } catch {
        $notes.Add("left out: $Path does not parse ($(ConvertTo-OneLine $_.Exception.Message))")
        return $null
    }
}

function Get-IntValue {
    param($Object, [string]$Name)
    $v = Get-PropertyValue $Object $Name $null
    $n = [long]0
    if ($null -ne $v -and [long]::TryParse([string]$v, [ref]$n)) { return $n }
    return $null
}

# One accumulator per row key.
$rows = @{}
function Get-Acc {
    param([string]$Lineage, [string]$Purpose)
    $key = "$Lineage`t$Purpose"
    if (-not $rows.ContainsKey($key)) {
        $rows[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
            Lineage = $Lineage; Purpose = $Purpose; Consults = 0; Usable = 0; Prose = 0; Failed = 0
            Raised = 0; Verified = 0; Rejected = 0; Wontfix = 0; Superseded = 0; Open = 0
            Accept = 0; Hold = 0; Reject = 0; Advise = 0; Yes = 0; Partly = 0; No = 0
            Walls = (New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[double]); TokensIn = [long]0; TokensOut = [long]0
        }
    }
    return $rows[$key]
}

foreach ($dir in $taskDirs) {
    $sessions = Read-TolerantStore -Path (Join-Path $dir.FullName 'sessions.json')
    $store = Read-TolerantStore -Path (Join-Path $dir.FullName 'findings.json')
    $keyOf = @{}
    foreach ($c in @(Get-PropertyValue (Get-PropertyValue $sessions 'codex' $null) 'consults' @())) {
        if ($null -eq $c) { continue }
        $rev = Get-PropertyValue $c 'reviewer' $null
        $lineage = 'unknown provenance'
        if ($null -ne $rev) { $lineage = Format-ReviewerLineage -Provider ([string](Get-PropertyValue $rev 'provider' '')) -Model ([string](Get-PropertyValue $rev 'model' '')) -Engine ([string](Get-PropertyValue $rev 'engine' '')) }
        $purpose = [string](Get-PropertyValue $c 'purpose' '')
        if (-not $purpose) { $purpose = '(none)' }
        $acc = Get-Acc $lineage $purpose
        $n = Get-IntValue $c 'n'
        if ($null -ne $n) { $keyOf[$n] = $acc }
        $acc.Consults++
        $outcome = [string](Get-PropertyValue $c 'bridge_outcome' (Get-PropertyValue $c 'outcome' ''))
        if ($outcome -eq 'usable reply') {
            $acc.Usable++
            if ((Get-PropertyValue $c 'structured' $false) -ne $true) { $acc.Prose++ }
        } else {
            $acc.Failed++
        }
        switch ([string](Get-PropertyValue $c 'verdict' '')) {
            'ACCEPT' { $acc.Accept++ }
            'HOLD' { $acc.Hold++ }
            'REJECT' { $acc.Reject++ }
            'ADVISE' { $acc.Advise++ }
        }
        $wall = Get-PropertyValue $c 'wall_seconds' $null
        $w = [double]0
        if ($null -ne $wall -and [double]::TryParse([string]$wall, [System.Globalization.NumberStyles]::Float, $script:Invariant, [ref]$w)) { $acc.Walls.Add($w) }
        $usage = Get-PropertyValue $c 'usage' $null
        if ($null -ne $usage) {
            $in = Get-IntValue $usage 'input_tokens'
            $cached = Get-IntValue $usage 'cached_input_tokens'
            $out = Get-IntValue $usage 'output_tokens'
            if ($null -ne $in) { $acc.TokensIn += [Math]::Max([long]0, $in - $(if ($null -ne $cached) { $cached } else { 0 })) }
            if ($null -ne $out) { $acc.TokensOut += $out }
        }
    }
    foreach ($f in @(Get-PropertyValue $store 'findings' @())) {
        if ($null -eq $f) { continue }
        $n = Get-IntValue (Get-PropertyValue $f 'source' $null) 'consult'
        $acc = $null
        if ($null -ne $n -and $keyOf.ContainsKey($n)) { $acc = $keyOf[$n] } else { $acc = Get-Acc 'unknown provenance' '(none)' }
        $acc.Raised++
        switch ([string](Get-PropertyValue $f 'status' '')) {
            'verified' { $acc.Verified++ }
            'rejected' { $acc.Rejected++ }
            'wontfix' { $acc.Wontfix++ }
            'superseded' { $acc.Superseded++ }
            'proposed' { $acc.Open++ }
            'implemented' { $acc.Open++ }
        }
    }
    foreach ($rt in @(Get-PropertyValue $store 'ratings' @())) {
        if ($null -eq $rt) { continue }
        $n = Get-IntValue $rt 'n'
        $acc = $null
        if ($null -ne $n -and $keyOf.ContainsKey($n)) { $acc = $keyOf[$n] }
        else {
            $p = [string](Get-PropertyValue $rt 'purpose' '')
            $acc = Get-Acc ([string](Get-PropertyValue $rt 'lineage' 'unknown provenance')) $(if ($p) { $p } else { '(none)' })
        }
        switch ([string](Get-PropertyValue $rt 'useful' '')) {
            'yes' { $acc.Yes++ }
            'partly' { $acc.Partly++ }
            'no' { $acc.No++ }
        }
    }
}

function Get-Median {
    param([double[]]$Values)
    if ($Values.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
    $sorted = @($Values | Sort-Object)
    $mid = [int][Math]::Floor($sorted.Count / 2)
    if ($sorted.Count % 2 -eq 1) { return [double]$sorted[$mid] }
    return ([double]$sorted[$mid - 1] + [double]$sorted[$mid]) / 2
}

$counters = @('Consults', 'Usable', 'Prose', 'Failed', 'Raised', 'Verified', 'Rejected', 'Wontfix', 'Superseded', 'Open', 'Accept', 'Hold', 'Reject', 'Advise', 'Yes', 'Partly', 'No', 'TokensIn', 'TokensOut')
function New-OutRow {
    param([string]$Kind, [string]$Lineage, [string]$Purpose, [object[]]$Parts)
    $sum = @{}
    foreach ($k in $counters) { $sum[$k] = [long]0 }
    $walls = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[double]
    foreach ($a in $Parts) {
        foreach ($k in $counters) { $sum[$k] += [long]$a.$k }
        foreach ($w in $a.Walls) { $walls.Add($w) }
    }
    $hit = $null
    if (($sum.Verified + $sum.Rejected) -gt 0) { $hit = [int][Math]::Round(100.0 * $sum.Verified / ($sum.Verified + $sum.Rejected), [MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero) }
    $median = Get-Median -Values ([double[]]$walls.ToArray())
    return [pscustomobject]@{
        kind                = $Kind
        lineage             = $Lineage
        purpose             = $Purpose
        consults            = $sum.Consults
        usable              = $sum.Usable
        prose               = $sum.Prose
        failed              = $sum.Failed
        raised              = $sum.Raised
        verified            = $sum.Verified
        rejected            = $sum.Rejected
        wontfix             = $sum.Wontfix
        superseded          = $sum.Superseded
        open                = $sum.Open
        hit_rate            = $hit
        verdict_accept      = $sum.Accept
        verdict_hold        = $sum.Hold
        verdict_reject      = $sum.Reject
        verdict_advise      = $sum.Advise
        rated_yes           = $sum.Yes
        rated_partly        = $sum.Partly
        rated_no            = $sum.No
        median_wall_seconds = $median
        tokens_in           = $sum.TokensIn
        tokens_out          = $sum.TokensOut
    }
}

$all = @($rows.Values)
$lineages = @($all | ForEach-Object { $_.Lineage } | Select-Object -Unique | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $_ -eq 'unknown provenance' } }, @{ Expression = { $_.ToLowerInvariant() } })
$out = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
foreach ($lin in $lineages) {
    $mine = @($all | Where-Object { $_.Lineage -eq $lin } | Sort-Object @{ Expression = { $_.Purpose.ToLowerInvariant() } })
    foreach ($a in $mine) { $out.Add((New-OutRow -Kind 'purpose' -Lineage $lin -Purpose $a.Purpose -Parts @($a))) }
    $out.Add((New-OutRow -Kind 'lineage' -Lineage $lin -Purpose '(total)' -Parts $mine))
}
if ($all.Count -gt 0) { $out.Add((New-OutRow -Kind 'total' -Lineage '(all)' -Purpose '(total)' -Parts $all)) }

if ($Json) {
    Write-Output (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject ([object[]]$out.ToArray()) -Depth 4)
    exit 0
}

Write-Host "codex-scoreboard: $collabRoot$(if ($Task) { " (task $Task)" } else { " ($($taskDirs.Count) task(s))" })"
foreach ($note in $notes) { Write-Host $note -ForegroundColor Yellow }
if ($out.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host 'no consultations recorded.'
    exit 0
}
$header = [ordered]@{ reviewer = 'REVIEWER'; purpose = 'PURPOSE'; consults = 'CONSULTS'; usable = 'USABLE'; prose = 'PROSE'; failed = 'FAILED'; raised = 'RAISED'; verified = 'VERIFIED'; rejected = 'REJECTED'; wontfix = 'WONTFIX'; superseded = 'SUPERSEDED'; open = 'OPEN'; hit = 'HIT%'; verdicts = 'A/H/R/D'; ratings = 'Y/P/N'; median = 'MEDIAN_S'; tokens = 'TOKENS' }
$lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$lines.Add([pscustomobject]$header)
foreach ($r in $out) {
    $lines.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
            reviewer   = $r.lineage
            purpose    = $r.purpose
            consults   = [string]$r.consults
            usable     = [string]$r.usable
            prose      = [string]$r.prose
            failed     = [string]$r.failed
            raised     = [string]$r.raised
            verified   = [string]$r.verified
            rejected   = [string]$r.rejected
            wontfix    = [string]$r.wontfix
            superseded = [string]$r.superseded
            open       = [string]$r.open
            hit        = $(if ($null -eq $r.hit_rate) { '-' } else { "$($r.hit_rate)%" })
            verdicts   = "$($r.verdict_accept)/$($r.verdict_hold)/$($r.verdict_reject)/$($r.verdict_advise)"
            ratings    = "$($r.rated_yes)/$($r.rated_partly)/$($r.rated_no)"
            median     = $(if ($null -eq $r.median_wall_seconds) { '-' } else { ([double]$r.median_wall_seconds).ToString('0.#', $script:Invariant) })
            tokens     = "$($r.tokens_in)/$($r.tokens_out)"
        })
}
$cols = @($header.Keys)
$numeric = @('consults', 'usable', 'prose', 'failed', 'raised', 'verified', 'rejected', 'wontfix', 'superseded', 'open', 'hit', 'median')
$width = @{}
foreach ($col in $cols) { $width[$col] = (@($lines | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_.$col).Length }) | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum }
foreach ($l in $lines) {
    $parts = foreach ($col in $cols) { if ($numeric -contains $col) { ([string]$l.$col).PadLeft($width[$col]) } else { ([string]$l.$col).PadRight($width[$col]) } }
    Write-Host (($parts -join '  ').TrimEnd())
}
exit 0

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    SessionStart hook: one line saying which reviewers are usable right now.

.DESCRIPTION
    Runs at the start of a Claude Code session in any project where the plugin is
    enabled (hooks/hooks.json). Prints ONE line to stdout, which Claude Code adds to the
    agent's context:

        codex-consult: reviewers - openai available | ZAI available | mimo unavailable
        (missing: env MIMO_API_KEY not set); roster -> would select ZAI

    or, when the Codex CLI is not on PATH, `codex-consult: codex CLI not found on PATH -
    follow the setup-providers skill`. Everything else (an unreadable config, an unusable
    roster, a crash inside the check) is reported in the same one-line form and never
    fails the session: the exit code is always 0. No network call, no lock, nothing
    written: it runs `codex-providers.ps1 -Json -NoNetwork` - the same local check

param(

    # under it). Relative paths resolve against the git repo root of the current directory.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$line = ''
try {
    $providers = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'codex-providers.ps1'
    $psExe = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
    $codex = Get-Command codex -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $codex) {
        $line = 'codex-consult: codex CLI not found on PATH - follow the setup-providers skill before consulting a reviewer'
    } else {
        $previous = $ErrorActionPreference
        $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
        $raw = & $psExe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $providers -Json -NoNetwork -CollabDir $CollabDir 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" }

            $selected = ''
            foreach ($r in $rows) {

                $short = $verdict
                if ($verdict -match '^(available|unavailable|unknown)\s*(\((.*)\))?$') {
                    $short = $Matches[1]
                    if ($Matches[3]) {
                        $reason = $Matches[3]

                        $short += " ($reason)"

                $parts.Add("$($r.name) $short")
                if ($r.roster_selected -eq $true) { $selected = [string]$r.name }
            }
            $line = 'codex-consult: reviewers - ' + ($parts.ToArray() -join ' | ')
            if ($selected) { $line += "; roster -> would select $selected" }
            elseif (@($rows | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.roster_position }).Count -gt 0) { $line += '; roster -> no entry is available' }
        }
    }
} catch {
    $msg = ("$($_.Exception.Message)" -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
    if ($msg.Length -gt 120) { $msg = $msg.Substring(0, 117) + '...' }
    $line = "codex-consult: reviewer check failed - $msg"
}
Write-Output $line
exit 0

423: # Thread id from the `codex exec --json` event stream.
424: # Ground truth (codex-cli 0.155.x): the FIRST JSONL line of every run - new, resume
425: # and fork alike - is
426: #   {"type":"thread.started","thread_id":"01a0c86d-4d77-7c01-98b1-f682bf63c677"}
427: # i.e. the event named "thread.started" carries the resulting thread in its
428: # top-level "thread_id" field. The other shapes below are version-drift safety nets,
429: # and they only look at SESSION-START events (type thread.started, session.started or
430: # session_configured, top-level or msg-wrapped): any other event may carry some other
431: # id (a parent thread, a sub-session) and is ignored for thread purposes. No thread
432: # here -> the caller falls back to the rollout rule.
433: $script:SessionStartEvents = @('thread.started', 'session.started', 'session_configured')
434: function Get-ThreadIdFromEvents {
435:     param([string]$Path)
436:     $text = Read-SharedText -Path $Path
437:     if (-not $text) { return '' }
438:     $uuidRe = '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
439:     foreach ($line in ($text -split "`r?`n")) {
440:         if (-not $line) { continue }
441:         $trimmed = $line.Trim()
442:         if (-not $trimmed.StartsWith('{')) { continue }
443:         $obj = $null
444:         try { $obj = $trimmed | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { continue }
445:         $type = ''
446:         if ($obj.PSObject.Properties['type']) { $type = [string]$obj.type }
447:         # primary: the "thread.started" event
448:         if ($type -ceq 'thread.started' -and $obj.PSObject.Properties['thread_id'] -and $obj.thread_id -match $uuidRe) {
449:             return [string]$obj.thread_id
450:         }
451:         # drift net 1: a top-level session-start event with a thread/session/conversation id
452:         if ($script:SessionStartEvents -ccontains $type) {
453:             foreach ($field in @('thread_id', 'session_id', 'conversation_id')) {
454:                 if ($obj.PSObject.Properties[$field] -and $obj.$field -match $uuidRe) {
455:                     return [string]$obj.$field
456:                 }
457:             }
458:         }
459:         # drift net 2: the older msg-wrapped shape ({"msg":{"type":"session_configured",...}})
460:         if ($obj.PSObject.Properties['msg'] -and $obj.msg -and $obj.msg.PSObject.Properties['type']) {
701:     $collab = Compare-DirectorySnapshot -Before $CollabBefore -After $CollabAfter -IgnorePrefixes $OwnPrefixes

704:     if (@($ChangedArtifacts).Count -gt 0) { $why.Add("artifact(s) changed during the run (by the reviewer or anyone else): $(@($ChangedArtifacts) -join ', ')") }
705:     if ($why.Count -eq 0) { return '' }

1: # R14 + R15 + R16 - companions: size by stakes, telemetry routing, roles (design for review, wave 25)
2: 
3: Goal: a panel takes as many companions as the stakes need, from as many labs as it can, chosen
4: by their track record with a share of exploration, and a companion can take a narrow role.
5: Today `-Panel` takes every available roster entry (weighty ones only on weighty purposes) in
6: roster order; selection is deterministic and telemetry (`-Rate`, the scoreboard) is only read
7: by humans.
8: 
9: ## Code facts
10: 
11: - `Select-PanelMembers` (common.ps1) walks the roster: availability (preflight, endpoint health,
12:   peak), then `panel: weighty` vs the purpose (`$script:WeightyPurposes`), `-PanelAll`.
13: - Ratings live in `findings.json` `ratings[]` (`-Rate <n> -Useful yes|partly|no -Note`), joined
14:   to the ledger entry by n; `codex-scoreboard.ps1` aggregates per (lineage, purpose) across all
15:   tasks of the repository (`Read-AllTaskConsults` reads every ledger already, for endpoint
16:   health).
17: - Purposes: framing, decision, checkpoint, core-contract, acceptance, diff-review, stuck, chore
18:   (+ none); presets set effort and max words.
19: 
20: ## Design
21: 
22: R14 - size and diversity
23: 1. Default panel size per purpose: checkpoint 1, diff-review 2, framing 3, decision 3,
24:    core-contract 4, acceptance 4, stuck: all available. `-PanelSize <n>` overrides (n >= 1);
25:    `-PanelAll` = all available (unchanged). The size counts members that will RUN; skipped
26:    entries never count.
27: 2. Lab diversity: optional roster field `lab` (free text, e.g. `deepseek`, `moonshot`, `zhipu`,
28:    `google`, `bytedance`, `alibaba`, `xiaomi`, `meta`, `openai`); default = the provider label.
29:    Filling a panel of size k: first one member per distinct lab (best-ranked of each lab), then
30:    the rest by rank. Validation: `lab` is a non-empty string.
31: 3. The design floor is a rule, not code: the consult-codex skill states that framing and
32:    decision questions go to a panel of at least one companion (never only the author's own
33:    judgement), and `-Panel` on those purposes warns when fewer than 2 members will run.
34: 4. Documented diminishing returns (README): past about five diverse members, findings repeat.
35: 
36: R15 - telemetry routing
37: 5. Rank = a score per (roster entry, purpose[, topics]) from the ratings of the last 90 days
38:    across all tasks of the repository: score = 1 + sum(yes) + 0.5*sum(partly) - sum(no), floor
39:    0.25; a lineage with no ratings on this purpose scores its all-purpose score, else the
40:    neutral 1. Topics: `-Topic a,b` on the bridge (ledger `topics[]`, the scoreboard gains
41:    `-By topic`); a rating counts for the topics of its consultation; the score for a topic'd
42:    request = mean of the purpose score and the topic scores that exist.
43: 6. Selection = weighted draw without replacement over the eligible entries (weights = scores),
44:    with exploration: with probability 0.2 per slot the slot is filled uniformly from the eligible
45:    rest. The RNG is seeded per panel (the panel id) and the ledger's `panel` object gains
46:    `routing: { seed, eligible: [{lineage, score, lab}], picked: [...], explored: [...] }`;
47:    the dry run prints the same. `-PanelOrder roster` restores today's deterministic order (and
48:    is the behaviour when no ratings exist at all: draw with equal weights = roster order? No -
49:    equal weights still shuffle; with no ratings the order is the roster order, documented).
50: 7. Single runs (`-Provider` absent, no `-Panel`): today the first available roster entry. R15
51:    changes nothing there (the coordinator asked for one reviewer; the roster order is the
52:    coordinator's ranking).
53: 
54: R16 - roles
55: 8. `-Role <name>`: a role block from `templates/role-<name>.md` appended to the prompt after
56:    the ask (edge-cases, security, tests, docs shipped; a repository may add its own under
57:    `.collab/roles/`), recorded as ledger `role`; `-Panel -Role x` gives the same role to every
58:    member; `-Roles a,b,c` (panel only) assigns roles in order to the picked members (the rest:
59:    none). Roles change the prompt only - members stay read-only, verdict rules unchanged.
60: 
61: ## Tests (fakes only)
62: 
63: Sizes per purpose and `-PanelSize`; lab diversity (two entries of one lab, one of another:
64: size 2 picks one of each); the floor warning; scores from synthetic ratings (yes/partly/no,
65: the 90-day cut, the fallback chain); the seeded draw is reproducible (same seed -> same pick)
66: and exploration happens at the recorded rate over many seeds; `-PanelOrder roster`; the
67: ledger's routing record and the dry-run text; `-Topic` in the ledger and `-By topic`;
68: `-Role` block in the prompt and ledger, unknown role refused, `-Roles` assignment order.
69: 
70: ## Questions for the reviewers
71: 
72: Q1. The score formula (additive, floor 0.25, 90-day window): sane, or should it be a rate (yes
73:     over rated) with a confidence prior (few ratings -> pull to neutral)?
74: Q2. Exploration 0.2 per slot: right order of magnitude for a roster of ~10 and a few panels a
75:     day? Any reason to make it decay with the number of ratings?
76: Q3. Diversity before rank: any case where it picks a clearly worse lab representative over a
77:     better second model of the same lab that the coordinator would regret?
78: Q4. Should a role change the purpose presets (effort, max words), or stay prompt-only?
79: 
80: ## Addendum (2026-09-26, the maintainer's request): availability the operator can act on
81: 
82: The maintainer: the operator should see, briefly, which reviewers are out on a limit and until
83: when, because some topics should not be started without a particular reviewer.
84: 
85: 9. Availability line, sharpened: the SessionStart hook line (and `codex-providers.ps1 -Short`,
86:    new) names only what is OUT, per roster entry (not per provider label), with the reset time
87:    in local time and a relative hint: `codex-consult: out - openai :: gpt-6-astra (until Sun
88:    20:35, 2d 10h), gemini :: * (until Sun 21:30); 9 of 11 reviewers available`. Every entry
89:    available: `codex-consult: all 11 reviewers available`. A quota failure WITHOUT a known reset
90:    (e.g. BytePlus 429 at 10:31 today, which the hook still reports as available) marks the
91:    endpoint "out (limit hit 10:31, reset unknown - retry after 60 min)" for 60 minutes.
92: 10. `-Require <lineage[,lineage]>` on `-Panel` (and on a single run with `-Provider`): the run is
93:     refused BEFORE anything starts when a required reviewer is unavailable, printing who and
94:     until when, exit 5; the dry run shows the same. The roster may carry the default:
95:     `"require": { "acceptance": ["openai :: gpt-6-astra"], "framing": [...] }` per purpose.
96: 11. The consult-codex skill: before a framing, decision, core-contract or acceptance panel the
97:     coordinator runs the availability check and, when a reviewer the topic needs is out, tells
98:     the operator who is out and until when and asks whether to wait or to proceed without them -
99:     never silently proceeds. The bridge's own summary already names skipped members; this rule
100:     moves the decision before the run.
101: 
102: Q5. Should "out" be judged per roster entry (two agy models share one quota - both out) or per
103:     endpoint group as `Get-PanelPlan` defines it, and how should the hook line stay one line with
104:     an 11-entry roster?

{"schema_version":"1","verdict":"ADVISE","verdict_reason":"The goals are sound, but the routing, diversity, availability and requirement contracts need precise semantics before implementation.","reply_markdown":"## Framing
The brief assumes usefulness ratings, lab labels and panel size are adequate proxies for review value. Missing alternatives: deterministic stratified rotation; Thompson/UCB routing; scoring verified-finding precision instead of judge satisfaction; diversity based on observed correlated errors or endpoint groups; operator-pinned members plus automatic fill; and budget-aware selection using cost, latency and quota. I would choose only after knowing rating volume/sparsity, its correlation with structured replies, panel budgets, cost/latency distributions, correlated failures by lab/endpoint, and whether the objective is defect discovery, independent consensus or reliable acceptance.

## Q1
Use a confidence-weighted rate, not the additive sum. For example `(yes + 0.5*partly + 2)/(rated + 4)` or a Beta posterior lower bound, hierarchically shrunk from all-purpose to purpose/topic evidence. The proposed sum rewards exposure without normalizing and its floor collapses all negative histories. Keep recency decay rather than a hard 90-day cliff.

## Q2
Exploration 0.2 per slot is plausible only cold: for four slots it expects 0.8 explorations and gives about 60% of panels at least one. It becomes expensive once evidence accumulates. Decay it with effective sample size or use posterior sampling; cap exploratory slots at one per panel.

## Q3
Yes. If lab A has scores 10 and 9.5 while lab B has 0.25, size 2 selects 10 and 0.25 instead of 10 and 9.5. Make diversity a soft bonus or reserve one seat only when candidates' confidence intervals overlap or scores are within a documented tolerance.

## Q4
Keep roles prompt-only. `codex-consult.ps1:713-735,936-939` already gives purpose presets and explicit overrides; silently changing effort or words by role would confound comparisons and telemetry. Permit explicit `-Effort`/`-MaxWords` as today.

## Q5
Judge quota/auth outages at the shared endpoint-group level, then project the state onto every affected roster entry. Display compact groups such as `gemini :: m1,m2 (until ...)` rather than provider-only rows or ambiguous `*`; show `all N reviewers available` otherwise. This preserves one line without losing actionable identity.
